title: Subtree of another Tree
summary: Return whether a node of root starts a subtree identical to subRoot.

contractDetails.constraints: Root has 1–2,000 nodes. SubRoot has 1–1,000 nodes. Values are integers in [−10,000, 10,000].

statement: Return whether a node of root starts a subtree identical to subRoot. The candidate includes every descendant of that node. Matching a subset of its children is insufficient.

examples.explanation: The left subtree matches in full.
The candidate 4 has an extra descendant.
A tree is a subtree of itself.

constraints: Root has 1–2,000 nodes. SubRoot has 1–1,000 nodes. Values are integers in [−10,000, 10,000].
hints: Conceptual: A matching root value is only a candidate.
Directional: Scan root and compare subRoot with each candidate using structural equality.
Implementation: For each comparison, check matching nulls, values, and the two child positions. Continue scanning after a mismatch.
complexityAnalysis: O(nm) worst-case time for n and m nodes. An iterative scan and comparison use O(h1+h2) auxiliary space for the two tree heights.
